messages:
incident-bot: Pager — billing/metering anomaly detected: token_count delta > 6% in prod (eu-west). Auto-escalation. Link: https://incidents.redwood/incident/8321991111 :rotating_light:
oncall-lead: ack. I'm oncall. starting triage.
sam: running quick recon on token emitter counts for last 2h, pulling logs now.
mira: overage flags fired ~10:12 UTC for ~420 customers, mostly low-volume. metric `billing.overflag` spike visible.
lee: seeing delayed ingestion from consumer group `kafka-consumer-12`, backlog ~1.2M msgs. that would cause delayed usage then a sudden emit.
sam: quick query output (sanitized):
```
SELECT emitter, count_tokens FROM token_ledger WHERE ts > now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5;
emitterA 123456
emitterB 0
emitterC 98765
```
shows gaps — some emitters returning 0s intermittently.
mira: customer-impact estimate: ~0.7% of monthly revenue, ~1.8% active customers. most are low-tenure/trial.
jordan: support: ~18 tickets since alert, subject line 'unexpected usage/overage'. tagging them `billing-incident`. prepping a short response.
lee: mitigation steps started — restarted `kafka-consumer-12` and launched backfill job `jb-8321` to reprocess backlog. watching for duplicates.
oncall-lead: risk of double-counting when backfill finishes?
sam: yes possible. I am adding a de-dupe window (message id dedupe) to the backfill pipeline and patching job config now.
mira: recommend suppressing automated overage emails until counts stabilize. I can flip the suppression flag for 30m to avoid customer noise.
jordan: I'll draft a customer note once suppression is on: "We observed delayed usage reporting which triggered short-term overage alerts. We're reprocessing data and will follow up with corrected usage and next steps."
oncall-lead: plan = suppress emails + backfill (dedup) + monitor. If stable for 30m we clear pager. Handoff: postmortem owner = mira + sam. lee shadows next hour. :thumbsup:
mira: taking postmortem ownership. collecting sample customer ids and error traces, will propose remediation and compensation if needed.
lee: monitoring dashboard up (alerts on token_delta and overflag_rate). will escalate if spike returns. :eyes:
incident-bot: automated checks show ingestion lag recovered at 8321991390 and overflag rate trending down. Pager status: resolved (auto-check passed). Follow-up thread created: #incidents-8321991111-followup"
